s2:Simulating Short Gamma-Ray Burst Jets in Realistic Late Binary Neutron Star Merg

rationale: Several direct candidates investigate the physical mechanisms and emissions related to GRB 211211A, including potential progenitor scenarios and emission mechanisms (2507.04318, 2304.04009, 2510.09744, 2304.00893). However, they do not fully resolve the question, indicating that it remains partially addressed.
